subject: Saving ScanTwo Output to work with on another computer

messages.author: 4c4091a92f5b965e
messages.subject: Saving ScanTwo Output to work with on another computer
parts:
Hello Dr. Broman and Google Doc members! 

I have three problems that I am currently struggling with and would appreciate any help you can offer.  I am working in a plant model with five chromosomes.  I am studying many phenotypes, but am measuring the phenotype four ways: Ambient, Elevated, Diff, Ratio.  For the purposes here, I am only looking at cell density (SD). 

The third (and most important) problem: 

My lab computer only has one processor.  So when I am trying to do 1000 permutations for a two-dimensional scan, the computer completes approximately 1 per hour.  To get over this computational hump, I am borrowing time on a neighboring lab’s Linux server (64 processors, using PuTTY).  This allows the analyses to move along quite quickly (comparably), but I am still spending a considerable amount of time on their server.  I have been trying to find a way to run the analyses in R on the other lab’s server, but then move the results to my lab computer so I can work on graphs and investigate the results.  The trouble is, any R.data file I save on the server and load onto my lab PC won’t return the same results.  The commands I am using are save(out.SD2Core, file="d:/file_name.RData") and load("d:/file_name.RData").  Should I be using something else?
